title: Workline design review record v1
description: An external review of one exact baseline revision. It lives OUTSIDE the baseline it reviews, so no digest is self-referential, and it never grants anything to a later revision.

target.description: The exact baseline this record decides on.

target_digest.description: The digest that baseline had. A record decides on BYTES, not on a name.

author.description: Who decided, or the role that did.

decision.description: `proposed` is the state a baseline is born in; only `approved` grants anything.

evidence.description: Optional: where the decision was taken. Never a substitute for the decision.

digest.description: SHA-256 of this record's canonical JSON WITHOUT this field.
